summary: Russian forces under General Gerasimov have advanced to within 1.5 km of Druzhkovka's outskirts and to within 4 km of Slaviansk's eastern edge, with street fighting reported in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka. Ukrainian drones struck a major Lukoil oil refinery in Nizhny Novgorod, forcing complete shutdown of processing operations, while additional Ozon warehouses burned in Blagoveshchensk. Italy is preparing its 13th military aid package including four Samp-T air defense systems and Aster 30 missiles, expected before year-end.
key_points: Russian General Gerasimov reported forces have advanced to 1.5 km from Druzhkovka's outskirts and breached the first line of Ukrainian defenses between Slovyansk and Kramatorsk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32786)

Russian units advanced to within 4 km of eastern Slovyansk with street fighting occurring in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka, and combat on airfield territory 3 km from Kramatorsk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32790)
Ukraine struck the Lukoil-Nizhny Novgorod oil refinery on August 26, causing complete halt of oil processing operations at Russia's fourth-largest refinery. (Source: @UkraineNow/83712)
Ukraine struck another Ozon warehouse in Blagoveshchensk, Bashkortostan—the seventh facility hit since August 22, following strikes on six other Ozon warehouses. (Source: @UkraineNow/83717)
Italy preparing 13th military aid package including Aster 30 missiles, Kronos radars, and Samp-T components, with Italy and France supplying four Samp-T systems. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32766)
Military recruitment officers stormed a store warehouse in Odesa attempting to mobilize a man. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32791)
Mandatory evacuation of children announced in nine settlements still under Ukrainian control in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32770)
FSB detained a 36-year-old Mariupol resident suspected of espionage for Ukrainian special services, collecting data on Russian military unit locations. (Source: @tass_agency/392236)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have advanced to within 1.5 km of Druzhkovka and 4 km of Slovyansk's eastern outskirts according to General Gerasimov, with street fighting in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka. Ukrainian strikes disabled the Lukoil-Nizhny Novgorod refinery, Russia's fourth-largest, and continued attacks on Ozon logistics infrastructure with seven warehouses now struck. Italy is preparing its 13th military aid package including four Samp-T air defense systems with Aster 30 missiles.

points: President Zelensky announced two new army groupings will strengthen Ukrainian positions in Donetsk region, to be commanded by Denys Prokopenko and Andriy Biletsky during his visit to Zaporizhzhia. Mandatory evacuation of children has been ordered in nine settlements still under Ukrainian control in Zaporizhzhia region.
Ukrainian drones struck the Lukoil-Nizhny Novgorod oil refinery on August 26, forcing complete shutdown of oil processing at Russia's fourth-largest refinery and second-largest gasoline producer.

Ukrainian drones struck another Ozon warehouse in Blagoveshchensk, Bashkortostan—the seventh Ozon facility hit since attacks began on August 22, with six other warehouses previously struck in various Russian regions.

Italian military aid package includes Aster 30 missiles from Italian stockpiles, Kronos radars, and Samp-T components, with systems expected to arrive before the beginning of next year. Italy and France have agreed to supply Ukraine with four Samp-T air defense systems and will allow Ukraine to manufacture Aster 30 missiles domestically.

Military recruitment officers stormed a store warehouse in Odesa and attempted to mobilize a man. A man was detained by Ukrainian border guards in Zakarpattia after attempting to flee the country by hiding in banana boxes and planning to swim across the Dniester River on an inflatable mattress, having paid $11,000 to smugglers.
A lawyer in Zakarpattia was caught wearing a 50 Cent mask while smuggling men across the border, charging a Kharkov resident $7,000; he had previously been convicted for similar crimes.

General Gerasimov reported Russian forces have liberated half of Alekseevo-Druzhkovka and advanced to within 1.5 km from Druzhkovka's outskirts, with 'Southern' group units breaching the first line of Ukrainian defenses between Slovyansk and Kramatorsk.

Russian units have advanced to within 4 km of eastern Slovyansk, with street fighting reported in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka. Advanced Russian units are engaged in combat on territory of an airfield located 3 km from Kramatorsk's outskirts.
FSB detained a 36-year-old Mariupol resident suspected of espionage for Ukrainian special services, collecting data on Russian military unit locations and deployments.
Kremlin spokesperson Peskov stated that media publications about alleged Russian aggression toward NATO countries have nothing to do with reality.
Maria Zakharova stated that Russia's response to Ukrainian strikes using British weapons could target any British military objects on Ukraine and beyond.
The Lukoil-Nizhny Novgorod refinery, Russia's fourth-largest and second-largest gasoline producer, completely halted oil processing following the August 26 Ukrainian drone strike.

Russian forces have advanced to within 1.5 km of Druzhkovka and breached the first line of Ukrainian defenses between Slovyansk and Kramatorsk in certain sectors, with street fighting in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka.
Combat is ongoing on territory of an airfield 3 km from Kramatorsk's outskirts as Russian units advance toward eastern Slovyansk, now within 4 km.

Active infiltration is occurring in Kostiantynivka where Ukrainian forces conduct constant clearing operations against enemy in buildings, basements, and ruins. Enemy expanded control westward after taking Illinka to expand encirclement.
Chasiv Yar faces greatest danger with enemy surrounding the city; positions inside are held but flanks are vulnerable, particularly the section above which threatens the garrison if it falls.

Enemy attention focused on Rajhorodok and Mykolayivka for advance toward Slovyansk; Rajhorodok is held but Mykolayivka shows enemy infiltration. Kryva Luka and surrounding area also show enemy presence.

Enemy hold important consolidation points in Orihuvatka and Rai-Oleksandrivka; Rai-Oleksandrivka shows successful infiltration but is being held. Command of 11th Corps has changed, expected to improve situation in that sector.
Reactive drones approaching Kyiv from multiple directions including Brovary, Vasylkiv, and north; multiple Shaheds circling over Kyiv with air raid lasting at least 2 more hours.
Reactive drone groups from Chernihiv region heading south; another group moving west of Chernihiv heading south; southern Chernihiv region reactive drone heading north.
Groups of reactive drones moving along the state border in Chernihiv region toward Kyiv Oblast; reactive drones in Tulchyn district, Vinnytsia region heading toward Zhmerynka.
Air raid alert in Kyiv issued with multiple reactive Shaheds detected; Kyiv air raid expected to last at least 2 more hours; all-clear issued at 11:09.
Destruction of reactive Shaheds continues on Kyiv outskirts.
Reactive drones from Black Sea heading toward Odesa region; reactive drones on southern Kharkiv region heading northwest; KABs (corrective aviation bombs) hitting Donetsk region.
Reactive drones on southern Vinnytsia region heading northwest; reactive drones approaching Kropyvnytskyi from east.
Ukraine attacked a trading center in the Osnovyansky district of Kharkiv with casualties reported by the mayor.
Three reactive Shaheds detected over Brovary with one circling over Vasylkiv; multiple Shaheds circling over Kyiv during active air raid.

Italy preparing 13th military aid package including Aster 30 missiles, Kronos radars, and Samp-T components; Italy and France supplying four Samp-T air defense systems with permission for Ukraine to manufacture Aster 30 missiles.
Reactive drones approaching Kyiv from north, with groups moving along Chernihiv border toward Kyiv; destruction of reactive Shaheds continues on Kyiv outskirts.
KABs (corrective aviation bombs) dropped on Donetsk region; reactive drones approaching from Black Sea toward Odesa and from multiple directions toward Kyiv.

CIA Director John Ratcliffe warned Russian leaders against escalating tensions with Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia during visit to Moscow and demanded Russia cease military and economic support of Iran.

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are conducting deliberate pressure operations toward Slovyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration, with advances to within 4 km of Slovyansk and 1.5 km of Druzhkovka indicating methodical progress through fortified Ukrainian defensive positions. The change in 11th Corps command suggests tactical adaptation after previous command failures. Ukrainian drone strikes against Russian energy infrastructure and logistics targets demonstrate persistent long-range strike capabilities, forcing shutdown of major refinery capacity. Multiple reactive drone waves continue targeting Kyiv and surrounding regions with active air defense operations.
sections.regional_response: Italy continues leading Western military support with its 13th aid package, including four Samp-T systems from Italy and France, representing significant air defense capability enhancement. Zelensky's announcement of new groupings commanded by Prokopenko and Biletsky indicates organizational restructuring in Donetsk. FSB detention of Mariupol espionage suspect suggests counterintelligence concerns amid active operations. Russian diplomatic response through Zakharova warns of retaliation against British military targets using threats to escalate pressure on Western support nations.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Russian General Staff's explicit reporting on advances to specific distances from urban centers (4 km from Slovyansk, 1.5 km from Druzhkovka, 3 km from Kramatorsk airfield) indicates willingness to publicize tactical progress. DeepStateUA reports infiltration in Mykolayivka and Kryva Luka areas suggesting probing operations for weak points in Ukrainian defenses. Ozon warehouse strikes demonstrate Ukraine's expanded target set beyond military objectives to include domestic logistics infrastructure. Italian-French Samp-T deployment represents Western escalation in air defense support with domestic manufacturing rights signaling long-term commitment.
